choices.label: Bike locks to x=640px; Atlantis viaduct scrolls right-to-left
Brief brass X-ray flash reveals engine piston & rider spine locked in rhythm
Road cuts to Causeway while momentum stays constant; watchers turn heads
Night sky dot-matrix flips column-by-column from indigo to chilly gold
Highway splits left/right; Poet rides straight up the painted center seam
Coasts to a halt beside the ruined shore chapel from Poem 03

I2_threshold.rule: 100% of sky dot-matrix flips to dawn and bike reaches ruined chapel (q_end >= 0.88).

I4_signature_constraint.constraint: Motorcycle center remains locked at x = 640 +- 2px across all 4 discontinuous world cuts.
